findings.title: earnings_verbatim:transcript_archive_coverage
findings.recommended_fix: Archive the missing earnings transcripts under `data/transcripts/<Quarter>/<TICKER>.txt`. Validator Pass 3c (verbatim gate) requires the transcript text be present for every quoted span in `data/bank_earnings.json`. See CLAUDE.md → 'Update Workflow (Q2 2026 onward)' for the full flow.

findings.title: validator_critical_count_divergence
findings.recommended_fix: Dev and prod produced materially different outputs on the same upstream data. Capture the specific anchor metric or signal that diverged, screenshot both rendered pages, and decide: is dev's behaviour the desired one (then plan promotion to main) or a regression (then revert/fix on dev).
